description: Java class ContentJsonEvents handling content association operations such as retrieving, moving, and deleting content associations in the OFBiz framework, including related web path alias management.

classes.name: ContentJsonEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for managing content associations, including retrieval, movement, and deletion within the OFBiz content management system.

methods.name: getContentAssocs
methods.description: Retrieves content associations for a given content ID, sorts them by title, and returns the result as JSON.

methods.name: moveContent
methods.description: Moves a content association from one content ID to another, updating relevant dates and cache.

methods.name: deleteContent
methods.description: Deletes content associations and related web path aliases for a specified content ID.

methods.name: deleteContent
methods.description: Internal method to mark content associations as expired and delete web path aliases.

methods.name: deleteWebPathAliases
methods.description: Recursively deletes web path aliases for a content ID and its associated sub-contents.

methods.name: getTreeNode
methods.description: Constructs a tree node representation of a content association, including content name and related children.
